arguments.command:
cd $GITHUB_WORKSPACE && git checkout -q -b ci/pi-action-trust-project && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='.github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml'
s=open(p).read()
old="          extensions: github:cv/pit#v0.35.1\n"
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,"""          extensions: github:cv/pit#v0.36.0
          # Load this repository's .pi/pit.json and .pi/functions (delivery.*, tests.*, pr.*), which AGENTS.md
          # relies on. Safe here: only OWNER/MEMBER can start a run, comment runs check out main, and fork PRs
          # get no secrets to mint the token.
          trust_project: true
          # pi-action's default is 30 minutes; use most of the job's 45, leaving time to save the thread.
          timeout: 2400
""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
python3 -c "import yaml;yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml'))" && git diff && git commit -qam "ci: run pi-action with pit 0.36.0 and the project's own functions

trust_project loads .pi/pit.json and .pi/functions, which AGENTS.md relies on;
timeout uses most of the job's 45 minutes instead of pi-action's 30.

Refs #358" && git push -q -u origin ci/pi-action-trust-project 2>&1 | grep -v "^remote:" ; gh pr create --title "ci: run pi-action with pit 0.36.0 and the project's own functions" --body "Refs #358

Changes to \`.github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml\`:

- **pit extension v0.35.1 → v0.36.0**, the release that just went out.
- **\`trust_project: true\`**: \`AGENTS.md\` tells the agent to use \`delivery.validate()\`, \`delivery.prepare()\`, and the other functions in \`.pi/functions\`. With trust off, pit loads none of them in CI (\`context.get().projectFunctions\` is empty in this run), so the agent can't follow the repo's own workflow. Turning it on also applies \`.pi/pit.json\`: \`allowedTools: [\"goal_*\"]\`.
  - **Security:** only OWNER/MEMBER can start a run (pi-action's default \`allowed_associations\`). Comment runs check out \`main\`. Fork PRs get no secrets, so they can't mint the App token. The \`.pi\` files that load are therefore ones a maintainer controls.
- **\`timeout: 2400\`**: pi-action's default limit of 30 minutes cuts off long tasks well before the job's 45-minute limit. 40 minutes leaves time to save the thread.

The other action pins are already the latest releases, and their SHAs match the tags: checkout v7.0.1, setup-node v7.1.0, dependency-review-action v5.0.0, create-github-app-token v3.3.0, pi-action v2.4.0.

Testing: I only checked that the workflow file parses as valid YAML. To check it after merge, mention \`@pi\` and confirm the agent can call \`delivery.validate()\`." 2>&1 | tail -1
